answer: Harbor control admits a key only at the willow buoy. The applicant locks 11.2 POA and clips an 8-byte relic tag to one licensed buoy, valid solely in the 15:20-15:26 tide gate. Two unaffiliated dock clerks from distinct quays, one tag each this epoch, rehash tag and gate within 7 minutes. Auditors recompute the buoy ID from the epoch seed and check the one-tag cap. A 4,700-key farm needs 52,640 POA and 4,700 unshared buoys in that window. A missed tide gate, a second tag on the same buoy, or a shared clerk burns 63% of the lock and benches those clerks for seven epochs.
